title: Dependent Censoring Based on Geometric Optimization
summary: In survival analysis, dependent censoring poses significant challenges in accurately estimating model parameters and survival functions. This study introduces a novel framework leveraging Extended Generalized Marshall-Olkin (EGMO) models to address dependent censoring mechanisms. Geometric optimization techniques are employed to develop efficient estimation procedures that capture dependencies between failure and censoring times. We establish their asymptotic properties. Simulation studies and real data applications illustrate the method's robustness and effectiveness.
